Original journal 2245 lines: DR 5300 = 6631.24; CR 2000 = 6622.24. The journal is unbalanced by 9.00 on the debit side. The invoice subledger says 6622.24, so the expense debit is overstated by 9.00.

The correction must bring 5300 down by 9.00 and keep the group balanced without moving AP away from the subledger amount. The rejected attempt added a 9.00 debit to 2000, which made the AP side net to 6613.24 (6622.24 credit minus 9.00 debit... i.e., 6613.24 net), which is why it was rejected. So the correcting line must not touch 2000.

The correct fix is a single credit of 9.00 to 5300 (reducing Facilities expense). Then the group nets as: DR 6631.24 on 5300, CR 9.00 on 5300 (net DR 6622.24), and CR 6622.24 on 2000. That balances exactly: net DR 6622.24 = net CR 6622.24, and AP stays at the invoice amount.

The journal group is then balanced in total? Original DR 6631.24 + 0 = 6631.24; original CR 6622.24; correction DR 0, CR 9.00. Totals: DR 6631.24, CR 6631.24. Balanced.

Period: 12 is open and within the allowed set; I'll use period 12 as the correction period. No status changes, since this is not a duplicate invoice.
